gaps: Breath one sorted the pointer's own question, designed at entry against improvised at the door, and the sort came out clean along a different line: every entry-designed exit fixes the stayers' take before anyone knows who will leave, so the leaving is an execution rather than a bargain, and every exit improvised between known parties is paid by the leaver, who has no veil to stand behind. Two items refused the sort: Reinsurance to close is designed but not by the deal, and the runoff book has buyers nobody wrote into a policy. This produced the changed question for breath two: when no veil was drawn at entry, what stands in for it?
accepted: Shotgun at the table: at deadlock either partner names a single price and the other must choose to buy or sell at it, so the namer prices honestly because they do not yet know which side of the trade they will stand on, as in the buy-sell clauses of two-person contracting firms; conserved is the business whole under one owner and a price nobody argued, the cost falls on the partner who cannot fund the buy, who sells at whatever the richer one names, and the next entrant learns to compare purses before signing; not a formula, since the price is discovered by the leaving itself, and it cannot be improvised because nobody names a price blind once they know they are the buyer.

Price fixed behind the veil: the exit price is a formula written at entry, book value or a multiple of trailing billings, as accounting partnerships and farm cooperatives pay a departing member out at par; conserved is the going concern and the relationship, since nothing is argued on the day, the cost falls on whoever the formula underpays, usually the leaver, who forfeits the goodwill they built, and the next entrant learns that goodwill made here stays here; not the shotgun, since nothing is discovered, and it works only because both signed before either knew which side they would be on, so after the quarrel no formula can be agreed.

Drag and tag: when the majority sells, the minority must sell with it (drag) or may sell with it (tag) at the same price, so one party's exit becomes everyone's on identical terms; conserved is a buyer who gets the whole and a minority that gets the majority's price, the cost is the minority's veto and the majority's freedom to sell alone, and the next entrant learns at signing whether their exit will be theirs or someone else's; cannot be improvised, since a minority not dragged at entry holds up the sale at exit, and distinct from the shotgun because the price is set by a stranger, not by a partner.

Queue at the door: exits are paced so that leaving does not force the sale that would hurt those who stay, as a fund redeems quarterly on ninety days' notice with a gate at a tenth of assets, and an executive's notice period holds the seat until the search is done; conserved is the stayers' value, the cost falls on the leaver in time, and the next entrant reads the queue's length as the printed illiquidity of what they are buying into; time, not money, and a gate written into the documents kept in 2008 the trust that a gate improvised that year destroyed.

Fork that keeps the commons: the leaver copies the whole codebase and leaves the name, as MariaDB left MySQL and LibreOffice left OpenOffice; conserved is the code for both parties and the name for the stayer, the cost is a split community and two crews maintaining one lineage, borne by everyone who depended on it, and the next entrant learns that the license chosen at entry fixed the exit, since proprietary code cannot be forked; copy rather than subtraction, and it is the trademark, not the license, that decides who keeps the name.

Name stays on the door: the founder retires and the firm keeps their name, as law firms are named for partners dead a century; conserved is the reputational asset detached from the person, the cost falls on the leaver, who loses control of what their name is now used to do, and on the stayers, who inherit every scandal the name will be attached to, and the next entrant learns that the name became the firm's on the day the shingle went up in firm form; the reverse of the curtain, since the name stays and the person goes, and it was designed at entry by the choice of what to paint on the glass.

Everyone leaves at once: the venture is chartered to end on a date or an event, as a film production company dissolves after the picture and a joint venture formed to build one bridge is wound up at the ribbon, so no one is ever the leaver; conserved is the relationship among the parties and a set of accounts closed and paid, the cost is compounding forfeited and the venture re-formed each time, and the next entrant learns they are entering a term, not a marriage; not a party's exit but the abolition of leaving, and unlike a notice period it ends the thing rather than the membership.

Reinsurance to close: after three years a Lloyd's syndicate year pays a premium to a later year to take over every liability still open, and the members of the closed year walk free of it forever; conserved is a home for every liability and a leaver who is truly out, the cost falls on the leaver, who pays the stayers to hold the tail, and the next entrant learns that the price of leaving a long-tailed promise is the price of the tail, and that when the tail cannot be priced, as asbestos could not, the year stays open and nobody leaves; not runoff, where the tail is held rather than sold, and an exit that pays the stayers rather than the reverse.

House kept on the children's clock: the divorcing spouse who leaves has their share of the house frozen in it until the youngest child is eighteen, the Mesher order of English family courts; conserved is a third party's use of the very thing the parties are dividing, the cost falls on the leaver in years of illiquidity, and the next entrant learns that some exits run on a non-party's clock; not a deferred sale by agreement, since a court imposes it on parties who could not agree, and the beneficiary is neither of them.

Chair filled before it's empty: the exit is dated by the successor's existence rather than the leaver's readiness, as a chief executive announces departure only in the sentence that names who follows; conserved is continuity of command with no vacancy for factions to fill, the cost falls on the leaver, who serves past their wish, and on the successor, who is known before they hold power, and the next entrant learns whether a bench existed; not a notice period, which is a duration, but a conditional date, and it can be improvised by any leaver willing to wait.

Runoff: the insurer leaves a market by writing nothing new and paying every policy to its natural end, as a carmaker leaving a country keeps shipping parts for a decade; conserved is the coverage the customers bought, the cost falls on the leaver in capital tied up for years in a shrinking operation nobody wants to staff, and the next entrant learns that an exit from a market lasts as long as the longest promise made in it; not reinsurance to close, since the tail is held rather than sold, and it needs no clause at entry, only capital.

Keys on the counter: the borrower who cannot pay hands over the collateral rather than defaulting into a foreclosure, the deed in lieu, the ship surrendered to the mortgagee at the next port; conserved is the collateral's value, spared a year of litigation, vacancy, and stripping, and the borrower's record, the cost falls on the borrower in the equity surrendered, and the next borrower learns that the loan was a lease with an option while the next lender learns that a clean surrender is worth a waived deficiency; bilateral and improvised at the door, not bankruptcy, which summons every creditor.

Sold to the people inside: the owner exits to buyers who were already in the building, the employees, usually taking a note paid from the business's own profits; conserved is the location, the workforce, and the knowledge in the hands that stay, the cost falls on the seller in a lower price and years of exposure to how the buyers run it, and the next entrant learns that an exit paid from the thing sold is not complete until the thing has paid; not a management buyout with outside capital, since the price is financed by what was exited, and it depends on a dated record of what was handed over, since every later shortfall in the note will be blamed on the day of the sale.

Cliff before the vest: equity vests nothing until a date and ratably after, as a founder's shares vest nothing for twelve months; conserved is a cap table free of dead equity from a departure in month three, the cost falls on the leaver before the date entirely and after it not at all, and the next entrant reads the cluster of departures at month thirteen as the date the company priced its people in; not a penalty but a schedule that makes leaving before the date cost more than after.

residue.item: Premium paid for the funeral: a buy-sell agreement funded by life insurance on each partner, so that when one exits by dying the survivors have the cash and the estate has a buyer.
residue.why: Merged into Shotgun at the table and its edge to Price fixed behind the veil: the mechanism is funding rather than price, and it earns its place as the repair of the shotgun's failure on unequal purses rather than as a separate exit; kept as the antecedent of the fork edge.

residue.item: Breakup fee: a deal exit priced at signing, so the party that walks pays a fixed sum and the other has been paid for negotiating.
residue.why: Rejected: carried by pivot-invariants' exit clause with a priced release; as a clean exit it is Price fixed behind the veil applied to a deal not yet closed and adds no new conservation.

residue.item: Non-compete: the leaver is barred from the trade for a term and a radius.
residue.why: Rejected as a nonmember: it restricts the leaver and conserves nothing across the exit, a wall rather than a door; used as the second boundary case.

residue.item: Source in escrow: the vendor's code held by a third party and released to the customer if the vendor exits by bankruptcy.
residue.why: Rejected: a witness architecture (arm's-length custody) built for the counterparty's exit, not an exit mechanism; the exit itself is bankruptcy, which the map excludes.

residue.item: Golden parachute: the executive is paid enough on a change of control not to resist the sale.
residue.why: Rejected: a side payment that buys the leaver's consent, carried by cooperation-mechanisms' compensatory side payments; it conserves the sale but nothing that the exit itself would have destroyed.

residue.item: Signed at the boundary: the handover with a witness, the shift log co-signed, the change-of-command ceremony, the exit audit, so that every later defect is datable to one side.
residue.why: Rejected for now: the mechanism is the witness, not the exit, and it is carried by witness-architectures at the level of the record; what it conserves for exits, datable responsibility, is kept as the dependency inside Sold to the people inside, where a note paid from the business needs it.

gate: declared modality, recognizable distinction, defensible seriation and conditional relations
limits: Authored conceptual fieldwork, not a taxonomy or a partition; a real exit usually runs several of these at once (a formula funded by insurance, paced by a queue, recorded at a witnessed boundary), and the list makes no claim to cover every kind.

'Clean' is taken narrowly: something named survives the leaving that the default exit, dissolution, foreclosure, or a fight over price, would have destroyed. Exits in which nothing survives, and departures in which the party never really leaves (a sabbatical, a silent partner), are outside.

The seriation, where the exit's terms were fixed relative to the leaving, is an itinerary, not a ranking of fairness, cost, or frequency; the reading that entry-designed exits work by a veil over who will leave is an authored interpretation, and map edges are conditional authored claims.

Illustrative cases (Lloyd's reinsurance to close and the open years, Mesher orders, noren-wake, the MariaDB and LibreOffice forks, deeds in lieu, LP secondaries, swing pricing, pay-to-play, film companies) are simplified to expose one mechanism each and are not claims about the specific histories; the swarm in Leave the comb is an analogy, and the timing claim carried by the Chair filled → Leave the comb edge is speculation.

Adjacent lists: pivot-invariants names the priced release and the release that leaves no veto as retained assets, and this map adds who buys the exit and who pays for it; cooperation-mechanisms names high exit costs and automatic sunsetting as stabilizers, and this map takes the exit itself as the object; cooperation-integrity-hinges' Exit bandwidth asks whether the door can be reached before exposure, and this map asks what the door is made of. What an exit 'teaches the next entrant' is what the mechanism makes legible, not evidence that entrants read it; nothing here has been checked against a set of actual exits.

gaps: The changed question yielded exits designed by the trade rather than the deal: Sell the seat, not the house (a market for seats), Dividing the curtain (a custom that lends the name), and the reclassification of Reinsurance to close as an institution-level design. It also broke two assumptions the first framing carried: that an exit is a subtraction (Sell the seat is a substitution; Fork was already a copy) and that an exit is a date (Fade by formula has none), and it split Queue at the door into time and money, yielding Swing price. Leave the comb arrived as the default beneath every custom, the swarm that takes what walks, and pushed the seriation's far end past improvisation to no fixing at all. Applying the sharpened type cut Cliff before the vest, admitted in breath one, as a fade with one step. The territory pointer 'clean exits' stands and the slug is kept; the of-sentence now names where the terms were fixed as the sort.
accepted: Sell the seat, not the house: the leaver's place is sold to a substitute the stayers accept, as a limited partner sells its fund interest on the secondary market, a tenant assigns a lease, a member sells an exchange seat; conserved is the venture untouched and a seat never empty, the cost falls on the leaver in the discount a stranger demands and on the stayers in the consent they must give, and the next entrant learns whether a market for their seat exists, which is a property of the trade, not of the deal; substitution rather than subtraction or copy, and the leaver is not gone but replaced.

Dividing the curtain: a long-serving employee leaves to open their own shop under the master's name with the master's blessing and no fee, the noren-wake of Japanese restaurants and shops; conserved is the name, now in two places, and the master's standing, which grows with each shop bearing it, the cost falls on the master, who loses the hands and takes any disgrace the second shop earns, and the next entrant learns that years served are the price of the name; not a franchise, since no fee flows and no contract binds, and not the fork, since the name is shared rather than kept by the stayer.

Leave the comb: the leaver takes only what walks, people and know-how, and forfeits every fixed asset to the stayers, as a swarm leaves with the old queen and half the workers and abandons comb, brood, stores, and a capped queen cell; conserved is the fixed capital, whole under the stayers, the cost falls on the leaver, who rebuilds from nothing fixed, and on the stayers, who lose half their hands, and the next entrant learns that what walked was never the firm's; an analogy from the hive, not a claim about bees, and not a fork, since nothing is copied, nor a buyout, since nothing is paid; the timing, leaving when the cell is capped rather than when the new queen emerges, is offered as speculation about firms.

Fade by formula: the partner who stops answering capital calls is not expelled but diluted on a schedule fixed at entry, as a venture syndicate's pay-to-play terms convert a non-participant's preferred shares to common at each round they sit out; conserved is the venture and the room, since nobody is thrown out and nobody leaves, the cost falls on the fader in slices with no single day to contest, and the next entrant learns that exit here is a slope, not a step; not a vesting cliff, which makes leaving a date around which the roster clusters at month thirteen, and not expulsion, since the fader may stop fading at any call.

Swing price: the leaver's exit price is adjusted by the trading cost their leaving imposes on the stayers, so a redemption on a bad day is paid out at a value reduced by exactly what it cost the fund to raise the cash; conserved is the stayers' value to the cent, the cost falls on the leaver in the amount of their own haste, and the next entrant learns that an exit has a price and it is printed on the confirm; money, not time, so a queue defers the harm while a swing charges it, and unlike an exit fee the amount is not fixed but measured on the day.

residue.item: Cliff before the vest: equity vests nothing until a date and ratably after, as a founder's shares vest nothing for twelve months; conserved is a cap table free of dead equity from a departure in month three, the cost falls on the leaver before the date entirely and after it not at all, and the next entrant reads the cluster of departures at month thirteen as the date the company priced its people in; not a penalty but a schedule that makes leaving before the date cost more than after.
residue.why: Cut when Fade by formula arrived: a cliff is a fade with one step, and the thing it made legible, the cluster of departures at month thirteen, is kept in Fade's discriminator; two schedule items differed in shape but not in what they let an operator notice.

residue.item: Gardening leave: the leaver is paid to sit out the notice period at home, unable to work for anyone.
residue.why: Rejected: Queue at the door with the cost moved from the leaver to the stayers; the conservation (clients not solicited during the search) is the queue's, and no new mechanism appears.

neighbors.right: Dividing the curtain: a long-serving employee leaves to open their own shop under the master's name with the master's blessing and no fee, the noren-wake of Japanese restaurants and shops; conserved is the name, now in two places, and the master's standing, which grows with each shop bearing it, the cost falls on the master, who loses the hands and takes any disgrace the second shop earns, and the next entrant learns that years served are the price of the name; not a franchise, since no fee flows and no contract binds, and not the fork, since the name is shared rather than kept by the stayer.
neighbors.separating_case: A sushi master retires and the shop keeps his name under his senior apprentice: the name stays and the person goes, the stayers inherit the reputation and its risks, and the entrant learns the name was the shop's. Years later the second apprentice leaves to open a shop across town under the same name with the master's blessing: the name travels with the leaver, the master forgoes the hands and takes the risk, and the entrant learns the name was the master's to give. Same name, same three people, exits in opposite directions, and the two cannot be told apart by the sign on the glass, only by who painted it there and whether a person or a firm holds the brush.

checks.boundary_case: Dissolution at will, the default of partnership law under which any partner may end the firm at any moment and force a liquidation, is out: it is an exit that destroys what remains by design, and every member of this map is a device built to escape it. A non-compete is out for the opposite reason: it restricts the leaver and conserves nothing across the exit, a wall rather than a door. Runoff is in on exactly that contrast, since the leaver stays bound but the customers' coverage survives.
checks.form_inference: The map shows a fork the sequence conceals at Shotgun at the table → Price fixed behind the veil: at entry the partners must choose discovery or formula, and which is safe is decided by their purses, not by the business. It shows a loop, Queue at the door ↔ Swing price, where a long queue causes the run it was built to prevent and the swing price that slows the run is itself a reason to leave. It shows a passage between levels at Runoff → Sell the seat, not the house, where a deal's improvised exit becomes the trade's designed one once a market for tails exists, and a second passage at Leave the comb → Dividing the curtain, where the default beneath every exit becomes a custom once the trade blesses it. It shows a dependency at Sell the seat, not the house → Drag and tag, where the trade-level market exists only where a contract-level clause pre-granted consent. And it shows an incompatibility at Everyone leaves at once → Name stays on the door: a trade whose ventures sunset cannot grow a name that stays, so its names attach to persons. The bare sequence would have shown none of these, since the seriation puts Runoff after Sell the seat and Leave the comb after Dividing the curtain, the reverse of the direction the edges run.
checks.target_preserved: Self-read only. Each item names one mechanism, what it conserves, who pays, and what it makes legible; the strange members (an exit that pays the stayers, an exit with no date, a seat that is never empty, a name lent for years served, a venture that abolishes leaving, a swarm that leaves at the capping of the cell) are kept as mechanisms rather than softened into advice about negotiating exits early or writing better shareholder agreements.

next_crossfield_opening: The stayers as buyer of last resort: connect Reinsurance to close with deal-flow-attractors' tollgates and witness-architectures' Ledger that makes the debt, and ask which exits require the stayers to price something no stranger will (a long tail, a name, a founder's followers), whether an exit market can exist for those at all, and what an institution looks like that lets a party leave a promise nobody can price without the open-years outcome in which nobody leaves.

gaps: The critic found the two edges carrying the deal-to-trade passage wrong in their specifics: a runoff book sold to a legacy acquirer is a seat whose value is below zero, so the leaver pays the stranger to sit in it and the substitute is accepted by a regulator or court on the policyholders' behalf, not by the stayers; and a tag right does not pre-grant a seat sale, only the minority's place in the majority's sale of the house, so the clauses that make a seat market are free assignability, consent not unreasonably withheld, and the right of first refusal, with drag and tag the same pre-grant applied to the whole house. The passage survives both repairs. The breath-one merge of the insurance-funded buy-sell into the Shotgun → Veil edge had lost what it claimed to keep; restored. The critic also found the type admits a right of first refusal that the list lacks, and that the third-party stage has business members missing (judicial fair-value buyout in place of dissolution, antitrust divestiture under a hold-separate order).
accepted: Shotgun at the table: at deadlock either partner names a single price and the other must choose to buy or sell at it, so the namer prices honestly because they do not yet know which side of the trade they will stand on, as in the buy-sell clauses of two-person contracting firms; conserved is the business whole under one owner and a price nobody argued, the cost falls on the partner who cannot fund the buy, who sells at whatever the richer one names, and the next entrant learns to compare purses before signing; not a formula, since the price is discovered by the leaving itself, and it cannot be improvised because the partner with the smaller purse, once purses are known, refuses a game whose only move for them is to sell.

Fade by formula: the partner who stops answering capital calls is not expelled but diluted on a schedule fixed at entry, as a venture syndicate's pay-to-play terms convert a non-participant's preferred shares to common at each round they sit out; conserved is the venture and the room, since nobody is thrown out and what the fader leaves is the syndicate's calls and its preference while their common stays on the cap table, the cost falls on the fader in slices with no single day to contest, and the next entrant learns that exit here is a slope, not a step; not a vesting cliff, which makes leaving a date around which the roster clusters at month thirteen, and not expulsion, since the fader may stop fading at any call.

Queue at the door: exits are paced so that leaving does not force the sale that would hurt those who stay, as a fund redeems quarterly on ninety days' notice with a gate at a tenth of assets, and an executive's notice period holds the seat for a fixed term whether or not a successor has been found; conserved is the stayers' value, the cost falls on the leaver in time, and the next entrant reads the queue's length as the printed illiquidity of what they are buying into; time, not money, and a gate the leaver signed at entry is read as the terms while a gate imposed by amendment on the day is read as a default, offered as the reading of why some 2008 gates kept their investors and others lost them.

Swing price: the leaver's exit price is adjusted by the trading cost their leaving imposes on the stayers, so a redemption on a bad day is paid out at a value reduced by an estimate of what it cost the fund to raise the cash, applied once net outflows cross a threshold; conserved is the stayers' value, as nearly as the estimate is right, the cost falls on the leaver in the amount of their own haste, and the next entrant learns that an exit has a price and it is printed on the confirm; money, not time, so a queue defers the harm while a swing charges it, and unlike an exit fee the amount is not fixed but measured on the day.

Leave the comb: the leaver takes only what walks, people and know-how, and forfeits every fixed asset to the stayers, as a trading desk lifted out of a bank walks with its know-how and whichever clients follow and leaves the book, the desks, and the name, and as a swarm leaves with the old queen and half the workers and abandons comb, brood, stores, and a capped queen cell; conserved is the fixed capital, whole under the stayers, the cost falls on the leaver, who rebuilds from nothing fixed, and on the stayers, who lose half their hands, and the next entrant learns that what walked was never the firm's; the hive is an analogy, not a claim about bees, and this is not a fork, since nothing is copied, nor a buyout, since nothing is paid; the timing, leaving when the cell is capped rather than when the new queen emerges, is offered as speculation about firms.

residue.item: Right of first refusal: fixed at entry behind the veil, it lets a partner leave to a stranger while conserving the stayers' choice of who sits in the seat.
residue.why: Not added: the critic showed the type admits it and the list lacks it, but proposed it as a finding rather than a repair, and the repairer adds no items of its own; it now lives in the Sell the seat → Drag and tag label as the clause that converts the stayers' veto into a match, and is left as a seed for cultivation.

residue.item: Reinsurance to close: 'the members of the closed year walk free of it forever'.
residue.why: Left as written at the critic's own decision: RITC is a contract of reinsurance, not a novation, so in law the members remain liable if the reinsuring year fails, a residue the Central Fund makes practically moot; the legal position is recorded in the boundary claims so the sentence is not read as it.

limits: Reinsurance to close's 'walk free of it forever' is the practical position, not the legal one, since RITC is a contract of reinsurance rather than a novation and the closed year's members remain liable if the reinsuring year fails.
seed: The Leave the comb → Dividing the curtain edge points at a stage it does not contain: a trade custom that blesses what walks without lending a name. The Protocol for Broker Recruiting is that stage in a real trade: the wirehouses agreed in 2004 not to sue departing brokers who take only client names and leave everything else, and the custom is testable because the firms that withdrew from it in 2017 resumed suing their swarms. Sitting between the swarm and the curtain, it would let the passage edge be read against documents rather than a hive, and it asks the operator's question directly: what does a trade get from blessing its swarms that it loses by suing them?
